title: CRYSTALLOSE
instructions: Sugar is contra-indicated in diabetes, because it aggravates the disease, in dyspepsia, because it produces fermentation, acidity of the stomach, heartburn, flatulence, etc., in corpulence, because it is a rapid fat former.
